senses.gloss: (b. h.; Job XXVII, 8) to draw out, pull.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 24a">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 107b:11">Sabb. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>השׁוֹלֶה דג וכ׳</he> he that takes a fish out of the water (on the Sabbath).

<cite ref="Chullin 63a:3">Ḥull. 63ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="U01340"><he>שָׁלָךְ</he></cite>, <cite ref="Leviticus 11:17">Lev. XI, 17</cite>) <he>זה השולה דגים וכ׳</he> that is the bird that catches fish out of the sea.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 2:3">M. Kat. II, 3</cite> <he>ושולה פשתנו וכ׳</he> and may take his flax out of the pond.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 966:4">Yalk. Koh. 966</cite> <he>אדם שוקע … שולה ראשון</he> if one sinks pots into his furnace, he takes out first what he has last put in; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 3:6:4">Y. Maas. Sh. III, 53ᶜ</cite> top <he>שולה</he>, read: <cite ref="U00544"><he>שורה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="U01936"><he>שָׁרָה</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: same, esp. to draw wine (out of the pit).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 56a">Ab. Zar. 56ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 92b:9">B. Mets. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>היין … משׁיְשַׁלֶּה בחביות</he> wine is subject to tithes …, when he fills it into kegs; Y. Ter. II, 41ᵇ bot. <he>משישלה ומשיקפה</he> (not <he>משיקיפה</he>) when he has filled and skimmed it; <he>עד שלא שי׳ וכ׳</he> before he filled or skimmed it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:7">Tosef. Maasr. I, 7</cite> <he>המקדיש … עד שלא שילה וקיפה מששילה וקיפה וכ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>שולה וקופה וכ׳</he>, corr. acc.) if one dedicates the contents of a pit before he has drawn and skimmed the wine, and the Temple collector comes after he has done so &c.; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 4:1">Gen. IV, 1</cite>) <he>ידע מאיזו שלוה נ׳</he> he knew from what happiness he was drawn away (through his wife).
